disposition_reason: Source-native rebinding can use the original ordered SOM reconstruction endpoint in Extended Data Figure2c,d: lower quantization error means better representation of the original unit feature vectors. Exact published region-wise errors, source map capacity/topology and complete source-to-unit joins remain unrecovered. Figure4 enrichment and hierarchy findings remain descriptive calibration; the local held-animal energy-score task is a different task.

source_paper.title: A prefrontal cortex map based on single-neuron activity

evidence.locator: Extended Data Figure2c,d; Methods: SOM feature vectors, architecture and initialization, SOM training; Figures1-2 and4
evidence.supports: Original quantization-error definition and region-wise median/IQR reporting, full unit population and feature standardization, fixed SOM capacity/topology, PCA initialization and200-iteration batch training; Figure4 descriptive mapping remains separate.

evidence.locator: Data used; Figure 2; Figure 4 code inventory
evidence.supports: Official SOM, enrichment and hierarchy workflow; source data destinations.
Historical registration distinguishes adapted held-animal predictive comparators from original published results.

evidence.locator: PFC Full99 conditional reconstruction participant task
evidence.supports: Supplied learned categories and ROI memberships, exact conditional moments, and deletion sensitivity are reconstruction only.

target.description: Represent each original KI wide-waveform unit's standardized [log10 firing rate, burstiness, memory] vector by its best-matching SOM prototype, assessed by the original Extended Data Figure2c,d quantization-error panel. Preserve original map capacity and topology; descriptive regional enrichment/hierarchy correlations are not optimization targets.

dataset.description: KI recordings are associated with DANDI 000473/001260 and paper-linked Zenodo 17559037. A complete publication-vintage file/version join has not been authenticated here.

cohort.description: Original SOM pool:19,186 wide-waveform KI units from all source brain regions/layers and99 recording probes. Extended Data Figure2c reports the10,413 PFC units by subregion;2d reports PFC overall and other regions. Preserve all source-eligible units and region membership.

split.description: The original QError panel measures representation of the same KI unit population used to fit the SOM, not held-animal generalization. Preserve this in-sample reconstruction condition transparently. A new held-out split can be useful but cannot be compared to original QError as same-task victory.

inputs.description: Original spontaneous firing metrics per eligible wide-waveform unit. Brain-region labels define the fixed reporting groups; they must not permit dropping difficult units or adding predictive variables. Freeze original node count, rectangular/hexagonal grid geometry and representation dimensionality before fitting.

preprocessing.description: The source extracts firing metrics from eligible3-second spontaneous epochs, averages them per unit, log10-transforms firing rate and standardizes each of the three features over all included units. SOM node count is manually chosen; map proportions/initialization use PCA and batch training runs200 iterations with a decreasing Gaussian neighborhood. Exact original feature values, unit masks, node count/dimensions and schedule must be authenticated.

metric.description: For unit j with standardized feature vector z_j and its nearest source-map prototype w_BMN(j), QError_j=||z_j-w_BMN(j)||_2. Lower is better. Compute in the same fixed standardized coordinates and original-capacity SOM; shrinking feature scales, adding nodes or replacing the output with per-unit memorization does not improve the same task.

aggregation.description: Extended Data Figure2c reports median and25th/75th percentiles of unit QError for each PFC subregion;2d reports the same for PFC overall and other brain regions. Preserve the full panel rather than selecting a favorable group or inventing a pooled scalar.

comparison.primary_metric: Original Extended Data Figure2c,d quantization-error medians across the complete fixed region panel

published_baseline.description: The primary paper explicitly defines and plots region-wise QError medians and IQRs, but exact numerical source values and the complete panel have not been recovered. Enrichment correlations, category counts and held-animal energy scores are not substitutes.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: The author SOM workflow and source-data figure route exist; no authenticated original-capacity map replay, per-unit QError vector or exact published-panel agreement is established. The local conditional scorer receives fitted categories and is not a SOM-learning baseline.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful reduction must be justified in the original standardized feature space after recovering reference variability and the complete region panel. Do not choose a generic error margin, increase codebook capacity or trade away required map neighborhood constraints.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired per-region QError comparisons with units nested within probes/mice, original region aggregation retained and stochastic optimization variability separate. Resolve a full-panel multiplicity/decision rule without presenting an in-sample reconstruction gain as held-out biological generalization.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Mouse for biological replication, with probes/units nested; independently initialized fits for algorithmic variability on the fixed original dataset.
uncertainty.rationale: Thousands of units are dependent biological observations, and the original error is measured on training-population features. Both dependence and the limited in-sample claim must remain explicit.

paper_win_requires: Recover exact original unit features, masks, standardization, source map node count/topology and Extended Data Figure2c,d QError values for every original region.
Reproduce the original-capacity author SOM and its complete region-wise QError panel before comparing candidate methods.
Freeze candidate map-learning method, original capacity/output constraints, allowed feature access, full-panel decision, meaningful effect, uncertainty and resource budgets before scoring.

Show a justified reduction of original QError under the full fixed-panel rule without changing node count, feature scale, population, representation constraints or source in-sample evaluation condition.

Retain Figure4 descriptive maps as calibration. Conditional-moment agreement, stronger hierarchy correlations or performance on a new held-animal energy-score split cannot satisfy this source-task win.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison has been verified; reproducing this finding establishes neither a paper win nor SOTA.

episode.improvement_loop: Blocked on source recovery. Once qualified, improve the original fixed-capacity SOM representation using declared access to the original training-population features; explicitly label all feedback as in-sample and preserve every original region.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze map-learning procedure, original unit/feature manifests, standardization, node capacity/topology, source error panel, uncertainty and budgets before final artifact scoring; output cannot encode one prototype per unit.
episode.final_evaluation: Compute the source QError formula for candidate and authenticated author prototypes on the exact original population, with every source region median/IQR reported. Any held-animal generalization evaluation is a separate extension.
episode.baseline_policy: The original fixed-capacity author SOM and its published QError panel define the baseline. Local fitted-category/conditional-moment graders and adapted held-animal distribution baselines remain separate calibration or extension artifacts.

blocking_issues: Original per-region numerical QError panel and per-unit prototype/feature lineage remain unrecovered.
Exact original SOM node count, grid geometry, neighborhood schedule, standardized feature matrices and complete unit/region joins are not authenticated.
No original-capacity native author replay or working same-task map-learning evaluator is qualified.
Meaningful reconstruction-error effect, full-panel multiplicity, dependence-aware uncertainty and concrete access/resource budgets remain unspecified.
The original score is in-sample reconstruction; held-animal forecasting and unrestricted codebook-capacity changes are different tasks.

legacy.notes: Retain complete map reproduction, conditional enrichment reconstruction, numerical graders and animal-deletion sensitivity as calibration. Source-native QError improvement must bind original fixed-capacity map learning; the held-animal64-draw energy-score design is an extension.
